title: Sequential Pricing with Deadlines and Correlated Buyers
summary: We study sequential posted pricing for selling a single item under an exogenous deadline: a seller makes take-it-or-leave-it price offers to buyers one at a time, stopping when some buyer accepts or the selling opportunity expires. We consider both deterministic deadlines and random deadlines drawn from a known distribution, and allow buyer valuations to be either independent or arbitrarily correlated.
